Gavinana — Florence, Italy

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Gavinana sits in Quartiere 3 (Gavinana-Galluzzo), which multiple reports based on Fondazione Caponnetto data identify as by far the safest of Florence's five administrative districts (around 8 recorded microcrime episodes over six months, versus well over 400 in the historic centre). One district crime summary did flag Piazza Elia Costa specifically for gang activity requiring monitoring, but overall this remains a low-crime, mostly residential area. Sources checked: La Nazione, Fondazione Caponnetto six-month microcrime report; La Firenze che Vorrei, quartiere-by-quartiere summer crime report (Quartiere 3 data).
